payout.rule: A crown is paid for at most 72 hours after it is won. Every crown still inside its 72-hour window gets one equal share of the miner emission (2 paid crowns = 50/50, 3 = one third each). A crown older than that earns nothing, even while it still holds the throne for duels. No crown inside the window = the emission burns. Revoked reigns are never paid. A hotkey with several crowns inside the window holds one share per crown. The throne and duel rules are unchanged.
